recommendation_summary: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat monitor that cron pings only after `nightly-sync` succeeds, which emails the user if the ping misses its daily deadline, and suggests testing it by withholding one heartbeat.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker for this task; neither is needed to detect a missed sync.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends its own email, so a startup crash also silences notification.
labels.Checked myself: Only your account of the setup and failure; no independent checks.

note: The reply recommends one heartbeat alert and grounds all four record lines in this case, but it brings in a Europe/Warsaw timezone that the situation never gave.
